In this article, we present KairosAD, an efficient image-based anomaly de-
tection model optimized for real-time deployment on embedded devices.

parameter efficiency. We demonstrated its effectiveness on multiple industrial
datasets and successfully deployed it on different embedded devices on a real
production line.
